title: StateTape: Action-Conditioned Evidence Lifecycle Modeling for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite the recent success of coding agents built on large language models, it remains challenging to run them over long horizons, since every observation is appended to the context and the context grows with each one. History-based maintenance is a common remedy, which masks or summarizes old observations, or prunes what a model reads as useless, and bounds the context at little cost. However, it decides from the text of the history alone and sees nothing of how the code is connected. Since a coding agent edits code many times over a single task, and each write can change what code elsewhere means, such maintenance may keep records a write has falsified, drop ones that still hold, and miss code the agent needs next. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes StateTape, a novel and scalable framework that rewrites a coding agent's context as the repository changes rather than as the context grows. translated_title: StateTape：面向长程编码智能体的动作条件化证据生命周期建模
translated_abstract: 尽管基于大语言模型构建的编码智能体近期取得了成功，但在长时程上运行它们仍然具有挑战性，因为每一条观测都会被追加到上下文中，上下文也随之不断增长。基于历史的维护是一种常见的补救措施，它通过屏蔽或总结旧观测、或剪除模型认为无用的内容，以极小的代价限制上下文规模。然而，这种方法仅依据历史文本来做决策，对代码之间的关联一无所知。由于编码智能体在单个任务中会多次编辑代码，而每次写入都可能改变其他代码的含义，这种维护方式可能会保留已被写入操作证伪的记录、丢弃仍然有效的记录，并遗漏智能体接下来需要的代码。为克服这些挑战，本文提出了 StateTape，这是一种新颖且可扩展的框架，它随代码仓库的变化（而非随上下文的增长）来重写编码智能体的上下文。StateTape 的关键思想是（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 StateTape 框架，通过动作条件化的证据生命周期建模，使编码智能体的上下文随代码仓库的变化而重写而非随上下文增长而维护，解决了传统基于文本历史的上下文维护无法感知代码依赖关系的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes StateTape, a novel framework that rewrites a coding agent's context as the repository changes through action-conditioned evidence lifecycle modeling, addressing the limitation of text-based history maintenance that cannot perceive how code is connected in long-horizon tasks.
